legal.privacy.title: Tasertit n tbaḍnit
legal.privacy.intro: Nḥareb isefka udmawanen u nseqdac-iten kan i umeẓlu n unadi ɣef tneqqiwin n tallalt.
legal.privacy.s1.title: Isefka yettwasqedcen
legal.privacy.s1.body: Nseqdac isefka n unadi d wadig s talast i tririt n tneqqiwin iqerben, war asufeɣ n wadig-ik i medden.
legal.privacy.s2.title: Amek tettwaseqdec
legal.privacy.s2.body: Isefka ttuseqdacen i usnerni n tseddi, asɣiwes n tmellit s umata, d ummesten n usqedac n tucḍiwin.
legal.privacy.s3.title: Akud n uḥraz d izerfan
legal.privacy.s3.body: Nṭṭaf isertan n uḥraz yesɛan akud, u tettḥaṭeḍ izeṛfan n usenqed, useɣti d tukksa ilmend n yilugan.
legal.terms.title: Tiwtilin n useqdec
legal.terms.intro: S useqdec n unagraw, tqebleḍ aseqdec ameɣtu d win yemṣadan taɣara tamadanit n umeẓlu.
legal.terms.s1.title: Aseqdec yettwasiregen
legal.terms.s1.body: Yettwasireg useqdec i usiweḍ n isalen n tneqqiwin n tallalt d uneqqis n tucḍiwin, war assexreb neɣ aɣelluy n umeẓlu.
legal.terms.s2.title: Tazdayt n isalen
legal.terms.s2.body: Nttqabal ad nleqqem isalen yal ass, maca addad n wannar yezmer ad ibeddel send ad yeẓra deg unagraw.
legal.terms.s3.title: Tamresponsabilit
legal.terms.s3.body: Ur yettwasireg ara useqdec urmeɣtu, u yezmer ad yili usbeddi n tigawin ilmend n yilugan yellan.
legal.cookies.title: Tasertit n cookies
legal.cookies.intro: Nseqdac cookies izadiden i tɣellist n unagraw d usnerni n termit n useqdec.
legal.cookies.s1.title: Cookies izadiden
legal.cookies.s1.body: Cookies izadiden ḥarzen tiɣimitin n tedbelt d tɣellist n yisuten n laman.
legal.cookies.s2.title: Asɣiwes d usnerni
legal.cookies.s2.body: Izmulen yemjumaɛen zemren ad ttwaseqdecen i usnerni n tmellit war aḍfar udmawan ur yesri ara.
legal.cookies.s3.title: Tifranin n useqdac
legal.cookies.s3.body: Tzemreḍ ad tesnefseḍ cookies deg iɣewwaṛen n uniminig, maca asensi-nsen yezmer ad iḥbes kra n twuriwin.
